Materialize actual captured Git blobs: ALL staged .github/workflows/*.yml and *.yaml, ALL indexed action.yml/action.yaml metadata anywhere in the repository, plus staged .github/actionlint.yaml/yml if present. This covers current reusable/composite input/output definitions without a second manually maintained call graph.

Use standalone temp project outside checkout, preserve relative paths, reject unsafe/symlink/gitlink metadata. If actionlint requires Git root discovery, create only minimal empty temp Git metadata, never clone. Prevent project/config/local-action lookup from walking back to real checkout.

Invoke verified binary from temp root with explicit complete workflow argv. actionlint owns local reusable/action resolution. Missing/deleted staged metadata must fail, never read the good unstaged worktree copy. Workflow/composite scripts are not executed.

Record full index digest, selected path/mode/OID/content map, staged lock, binary hash, argv/raw/actual exit. Re-read full index after execution and reject changes. Zero workflows, unavailable blob, mismatched tool/config or invocation failure cannot pass.

Driver --staged must enforce this when called directly, independently of pre-commit stashing or TDD fallback. Hook pass_filenames:false/always_run:true; no subset selection. CI uses same full-index mode on clean checkout.
